title: El Dorado Film Festival showcases independent film in South Arkansas - NewsBreak
text:
By Arkansas Style team ,
1 days ago Tamra Corley Davis, board president of the El Dorado Film Festival, discusses the upcoming festival running February 25th through March 1st. Independent film takes center stage in South Arkansas as the festival returns with films from across the country, featuring everything from award-winning films to workshops and interactive events. She shares what makes this event so special and why it continues to grow year after year. Read full article
